unattended_notice: ⚠ Unattended + no kernel boundary (non-TTY stdin, sandbox off, not read-only): actions that need approval are REJECTED outright (terminal_exec is unusable in CI), while write/execute tools that need no approval (file_write / code_execute / api_post …) run under in-process policy only. For unattended runs pass --sandbox job/docker (optionally --approval-policy on_failure), or go back to --permission readonly.
mcp_ready: (MCP server ready · HooH {version} · permission {permission} · sandbox {sandbox} · project {root})
sandbox_preflight_job_non_windows: ⚠ --sandbox job is a Windows-only Job Object primitive and cannot work on this platform: startup is not blocked, but the first terminal_exec / code_execute will honestly return 503 (it never falls back to the host). On Linux/macOS use --sandbox docker (one-shot container), or accept the in-process policy layer of the off tier.
sandbox_preflight_job_no_executor: ⚠ --sandbox job needs the Go executor but its binary was not found: the first call will return 503. Run `ace --install-executor` (official prebuilt, no local Go needed), or `cd executor && go build -o ace-executor(.exe) .`.
sandbox_preflight_docker_no_cli: ⚠ --sandbox docker needs the Docker CLI, and `docker` is not on PATH: the first call will return 503 (no fallback to the host). Install/start Docker and retry, or stay on the off tier (in-process policy only).
policy_refused_never_without_boundary: ❌ Refusing to start: approval_policy=never (never ask) + sandbox=off (no kernel boundary). `never` does not add dangerous actions (anything needing approval is denied), but it does not stop the tools that need no approval (file_write / code_execute / api_post …) — no human plus no boundary means no boundary. For unattended runs give a real boundary: --sandbox job or --sandbox docker (optionally with --approval-policy on_failure for try-then-ask).
policy_refused_never_with_danger_full_ac: ❌ Refusing to start: approval_policy=never + sandbox_policy=danger_full_access. ADR-002 states this combination has no legitimate use (unattended with no isolation). Use workspace_write / read_only, or give a real boundary with --sandbox job|docker.
max_rounds: ⚠ Reached max rounds, Agent did not give a final reply.
unverified_claim: ⚠ The model claimed the action was done, but no tool ran this round — nothing actually happened. Asked it to call a tool for real.
unverified_claim_final: ⚠ The "done" above is fabricated: no tool was executed in this turn and nothing on disk changed. Use a larger tool-calling model, or verify with /status.

cmd_style: Output style presets: one preset drives both the prompt and how much the UI shows (/style [default|concise|explanatory|strict])

style_default_desc: No extra instruction; display is decided by the individual switches
style_concise_desc: Fewer words, no pleasantries; the UI keeps only the summary (no thinking, diffs capped at 40 lines)
style_explanatory_desc: One line of why before each action, plus trade-offs and pitfalls; the UI shows thinking and full cards
style_strict_desc: Report only what was verified: no "done" without a tool result, and say plainly when something could not be checked
cmd_term: Terminal capabilities (truecolor/alt screen/Unicode/mouse); /term check asks about the parts that cannot be probed
term_hint: /term check: are colours right, is Unicode clean, does the mouse work — autodetection cannot answer those, and you only find out it guessed wrong when the screen looks broken
term_probe_intro: Terminal capability self-check (Enter = default · b = back · Ctrl+C = cancel)
term_probe_saved: Recorded {n} probe answers (they override autodetection and are saved to the config)
cap_probe_color_ask: Do the boxes and text above have colour? (y/n)
cap_probe_unicode_ask: Do the glyphs render correctly (no boxes/question marks)? (y/n)
keys_enter: send (fills the selected completion first when the menu is open)
keys_search_history: reverse search history one entry at a time (cross-session)
keys_history_fuzzy: fuzzy-search history by keyword (dsk finds deepseek)
keys_expand: expand the last folded output / diff
keys_stash: stash the current input (/stash pop to restore)
keys_escape: quit on empty input; closes the completion menu first when open
keys_ctrl_c: clears input first; twice on an empty line quits
keys_bash: run a local command directly and paste its output into context (not via the model, still through the execution layer)
keys_help: a lone ? plus Enter shows this table
paste_folded: (paste folded into a placeholder: {n} lines; expanded automatically on submit)
bash_usage: Usage: !<command> (runs directly, through the execution layer; e.g. !git status)
bash_in_context: Output pasted into the conversation context.
stash_restored: Restored ({n} chars) into the prompt — press Enter to send.
queue_added: Queued ({n}); runs automatically after this turn.
queue_usage: Usage: /queue <text> (runs after the current turn) · /queue clear
perm_opt_session: Allow for this session (stop asking for this kind of tool)
perm_opt_once_hint: Run just this once; authorization state is unchanged
perm_opt_session_hint: Stop asking for this kind of tool for the rest of the session — a real expansion of authority
perm_opt_deny_hint: Deny, and let the model try another way
perm_deny_feedback_hint: Enter to deny · Esc to drop the reason
perm_dialog_hint: ↑↓ choose · 1/2/3 pick · Enter confirm · Esc deny · n deny with a reason
perm_hint_keys: ↑/↓ choose · Enter confirm · 1/2/3 pick · Esc = deny
turn_hint_idle: Enter send · / commands · @ files · F1 help
turn_hint_busy: working — typing now queues it ({n} queued) · Esc to interrupt
turn_hint_interrupting: interrupting… (press again to abandon this turn)
turn_hint_queued: {n} queued, they run right after this turn
mode_write: write (file changes still ask every time)
mode_full: full (no per-action prompt — be sure you mean it)
tui_input_placeholder: Type a message; / for commands, @ for files, Shift+Tab for permission
tui_subtitle: component UI · you can type while it works
tui_queue_full: ✗ Queue is full: let this turn finish (Esc interrupts)
tui_queued: · Queued #{n}: it runs as soon as this turn finishes
tui_interrupting: ⏳ Interrupting: stops after the current step (Ctrl+C again abandons the turn)
tui_abandoned: ✗ Turn abandoned (the worker is still winding down; its output is dropped); dropped {n} queued
tui_no_mode_switch: This host has no mode switch (use /permission <mode>)
tui_mode_confirm: ⚠ {mode} removes per-action approval: press Shift+Tab again to confirm
tui_help_title: Keyboard (generated from the keymap: everything listed here is really bound)
tui_help_shown: Help was printed into the transcript (scroll up)
interrupt_before_tool: Interrupted: {tool} was not executed (stopping before a tool is the clean spot)
model_pick: Pick a model (type to filter, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel)
provider_pick: Pick a provider (type to filter, Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel)
choice_hint_choose: ↑↓ pick · type to filter · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
find_title: Find in transcript (Enter to search, Ctrl+F again for the next hit)
find_hit: · Hit {n}/{total} for "{q}" (Ctrl+F for the next one)
tui_draft_cleared: · Draft cleared (saved to history — press Up to recall)
rewind_talk: Conversation only: drop the last turn (/rewind)
tui_sent_now: · Sent now (current turn and queue handled together)
tui_editor_failed: ✗ Editor failed to start ({err}) — your draft is still in the prompt
tui_image_none: · No image on the clipboard (Ctrl+V only acts when there is one; text paste is unaffected)
tui_image_failed: ✗ Could not attach that image (unsupported format/size?)
tui_image_attached: · Image attached — it will be sent to the model provider with your next message
tui_invisible_stripped: · Removed {n} invisible characters (zero-width / bidi controls love to hide in pastes)
perm_comment_placeholder: Add a note to this decision (Tab to close); on deny it goes back to the model
home_sec_resume: Pick up where you left off
home_resume_last_hint: Enter to continue / ↑↓ to pick another
home_new_hint: clear context and open a fresh session (Alt+N)
home_effort_hint: auto → low → medium → high → max (Alt+T cycles)
home_lang_hint: 中文 / English / 日本語 (Alt+L cycles)
home_hint: ↑↓ choose · Enter run · or just type below (/ commands · @ files · ! shell · F1 help)
effort_title: Thinking effort (separate from /thinking: that one shows the reasoning, this one sets how deep it goes)
effort_hint_added: added to the system prompt (applies from the next turn)
effort_hint_none: auto: no extra instruction — the model's own default
effort_auto_what: no extra instruction, use the model default
effort_low_what: conclusion and minimal change, no alternatives
effort_medium_what: think through the tradeoffs, say only what changes the answer
effort_high_what: assumptions + alternatives, weigh each, say why the others lost
effort_turn_override: this turn runs at 「{level}」 ({what}) — keyword escape hatch, cleared after
lang_usage: usage: /lang {{{names}}} (UI only — to change the reply language, just say so in the chat)
new_session_done: new conversation started (context cleared; history will show it as its own entry)
new_session_failed: could not create the new session file ({err}) — context is cleared but this part goes into the old file
net_thinking_on: web-aware answers: ON — factual questions get searched first, with sources listed
net_thinking_off: web-aware answers: OFF — no network; answers rely on existing knowledge and local files
rewind_no_turns: · Nothing to rewind yet (this rewinds turns and file snapshots)
rewind_both: Drop back to this turn and restore files ({n} turns)
rewind_files_latest: Files only, to the latest snapshot ({id})
cmd_lang: Switch the UI language: 中文/English/日本語 (buttons, hints, errors, status bar)
cmd_new: start a new conversation (fresh session file + cleared context)
cmd_home: show the home panel again (sections and current state)
effort_max_what: beyond high: restate the problem, say how you will verify, name what is uncertain
context_window_now: context window updated with the model: {model} → {n} tokens
cmd_window: Show/set the context window (differs per model; if unknown, set it: /window 1m)
window_usage: usage: /window <tokens> to set (1m / 200k work) · /window auto to go back to auto
window_bad: Not a valid window size: {arg} (e.g. /window 1000000 or /window 1m)
window_unknown_hint: Window unknown (model {model} is not in the known table) → assuming {n} tokens; if it really is 1M, run /window 1m
fe_render_error: UI render error (details were written to stderr)
fe_render_error_hint: Press Ctrl+C to quit; paste that stderr text to the maintainer.
picker_hint_single: ↑↓ move · PgUp/PgDn page · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
picker_hint_multi: ↑↓ move · Tab toggle · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
stree_empty: No branch data (the engine returned no session tree).
stree_hint: ↑↓ move · Enter switch to that branch · Esc exit
set_hint_list: ↑↓ move · ←→ change · Enter confirm (applies immediately) · / search · Esc back
set_hint_search: Type to filter · ↑↓ select · Enter keeps the filter · Esc clears
set_hint_edit: Type a new value · Enter writes it · Esc cancels
set_no_write: Change this one in the /config wizard (not editable here)
